comments.author: Orakio
comments.body:
So, i made this item and tryed to sell it around all market keepers of important towns of Europe (London, Seville, Lisbon, Athens, Istambul, Alexandria, Stockholm, St. Petesburg, Etc...) and, at 100% market rate, it sell for the same price everywhere: 20k ducats.

Don't need to tell that it don't worth the enfort since the base item itself (ramie) sells better than the final product, also the time spent collecting large leaves (since it's the only way to obtain cochineal) make this unreasonable to work.
